$comment: Source: SEMH audit 2026-08-04, adapted. Machine-readable record of one lesson review. Ratings are professional judgement, NOT inspection grades, and a strong average never overrides a red gate.

path.description: Repository-relative path. Humanities lessons live at {Build,Grow,Launch}/Slideshows/, not Humanities_Teesside/.

reviewed_at_sha.description: Full SHA the review was measured at. A review without one is undated evidence.

gate.description: RED is a blocker on delivery, not a summary of quality. A strong average does not override it.

readiness_state.description: See DELIVERY_READINESS_CHECKLIST.md. States 5-6 are centre actions no repository change can close. State 7 requires a browser-capable environment.

independence.$comment: Paper/TA-side observation only. Never persisted to a pupil device, never aggregated, never a register or a score.

verdict.description: Every claim carries a verdict measured at reviewed_at_sha before any fix is built on it.

basis.description: Whether the reviewer measured it, or inherited it from an earlier record. A recorded figure names the commit and the branch it was measured on.

evidence.description: file:line and the quoted string. Not a paraphrase.

count_universe.description: e.g. "tracked *.html at <sha>". A count without a universe is not a measurement.

zero_replayed_against.description: Required when count is 0: the input where the same detector MUST fire.

assessed.description: If true: byte-identical or STOP. Report only.

frozen.description: Legacy science, frozen for 2025-26 delivery. Proposed diffs only, zero edits.

overlapping_branch.description: A live or parked branch also touching this path. Any overlap makes the item HELD.

print_pack_718x1047.description: UNVERIFIED where no browser-capable environment was available. Skipped is never 'pass'.

sentinel_derivation_unchanged.description: ll-g:loop-mark v1 set identical before and after. DERIVE the count; do not assume it.
